failed_or_abandoned: First exact_test implementation multiplied the null tail by (1-q_dead)^N twice (the FFT power of the un-normalised pmf already carries it); corrected before results were recorded
Livetime-gap block produced NaN per-event statistics inside the gap (0/0); fixed by zero-weight unit-ratio gap bins
Toy MC (1e4) cannot resolve 5 sigma tails; kept only as a cross-check of the exact convolution at p > 1e-3
Lisanti-k and SHM++ tail shapes not propagated (not exposed by lz.wd_halo); their rate effect taken from P018 tables, their shape effect bracketed by v_esc/v0 variants
